subject: MedicaCorp PO + billing fields / net terms discussion
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medicacorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@medicacorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Purchase order details + invoice cadence

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the product overview — MedicaCorp is keen to move forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a few billing/PO items before we issue a PO:

- We require the PO number on every invoice and a consolidated monthly invoice per entity (one invoice per month covering all usage).
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for our vendors. Is Redwood able to support Net45?
- If we can offer an early-pay option (Net15) we'd like to understand the discount you can provide for early payment.
- Please confirm the invoice delivery email (AP contact) and whether you can include a separate field on the invoice for our internal cost center (bill_to_entity).

I've attached our standard PO template to give you procurement's required fields. If you have a preferred invoice template or any limitations (e.g., minimum invoice amounts, consolidated vs. per-subscription invoices), let me know.

Attachment: MedicaCorp_PO_Template_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate a short call if easier to align.

Regards,
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager | MedicaCorp
agomez@medicacorp.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medicacorp.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-08T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order details + invoice cadence

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a few constraints from our side: 

- PO on invoice: yes, we always include the PO number when provided. We can also add a "bill_to_entity" line to the invoice if procurement requires that field populated.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: we can produce one consolidated invoice per entity, delivered monthly. Our billing system aggregates usage by account id. 
- Net terms: our standard is Net30. We can accept Net45 in specific enterprise cases but that requires a short approval from finance or a small prepayment reserve during the first 90 days to mitigate exposure.
- Early-pay discount: we can offer 1% for Net15 on recurring usage when tied to a 12-month committed usage minimum (we typically require an MRR/commitment threshold to make the discount viable).
- Invoice delivery: we can send invoices to a designated AP mailbox (please confirm). We also support additional CC addresses on invoice delivery.

If MedicaCorp needs Net45 without reserve, we can escalate to an exceptions committee — that would require procurement to sign a short amendment to the standard terms.

I've attached a short summary of our invoicing policy so procurement can see how we format consolidated charges and PO metadata. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on fields.

Attachment: Redwood_Invoicing_Policy_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: MedicaCorp PO negotiation plan

Vanessa / Vivek — quick internal note before I send the counter-proposal to Alicia. Key asks from MedicaCorp: Net45, consolidated monthly invoice, bill_to_entity field, and early-pay option. Proposed negotiation posture: 

- Offer consolidated monthly invoice and include bill_to_entity mapping — low friction.
- Approve Net45 for the account but require a 10% prepayment reserve hold for the first 90 days (applied to usage overage) or, alternatively, require an enterprise monthly commit (12-month commit) without reserve. This reduces finance exposure.
- Early-pay discount: offer 0.75% for Net15 unconditionally; increase to 1% if they commit to a 12-month minimum spend band.
- Ask procurement to confirm AP mailbox and cost-center format; we populate bill_to_entity but need a deterministic mapping to our account id for consolidated invoices.

If we get buy-in, I'll draft a short amendment and propose a one-call alignment with procurement + AP to confirm invoice fields and delivery address. Thoughts?

—Marissa

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medicacorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@medicacorp.com>, procurement_ops@medicacorp.com
Date: 2026-09-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order details + invoice cadence

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Procurement discussed this and can accept the approach with a couple tweaks: 

- We can agree to an initial 90-day prepayment reserve as you suggested, applied only if usage exceeds the monthly committed baseline. That should be acceptable to finance.
- MedicaCorp prefers the 1% early-pay discount for Net15, but that's contingent on a 12-month usage commitment. If you can give us language for the commitment (baseline MRR / committed spend band), we'll run it through legal.
- Invoice delivery should be: ap@medicacorp.com with a CC to vendor_onboarding@medicacorp.com. Please ensure each invoice includes a "bill_to_entity" field populated exactly as: "MedicaCorp - Clinical Ops".

If you can update the SOW/amendment to reflect: consolidated monthly invoice, PO number on invoice, bill_to_entity population, Net45 with initial 90-day reserve OR Net30 with no reserve (we'll take Net45+reserve), and the 1% Net15/12-month-commit clause, we can get procurement and legal to sign quickly. Attached is the PO with a final procurement header for your reference.

Attachment: MedicaCorp_PO_Final.pdf (application/pdf)

I'll leave Tom on the thread for AP routing. We can do a quick call Thursday if you prefer.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager | MedicaCorp
agomez@medicacorp.com
